name: Cirrus SF50 Vision Jet
summary: Single-engine personal jet with a whole-airframe parachute; the most-delivered business jet each year since 2019.

engines: Single Williams FJ33 turbofan buried on top of the rear fuselage, intake behind the cabin
fuselage: Short, rounded composite fuselage with a big wraparound windscreen
Large windows and a nose similar to a Cirrus piston single
tail: V-tail (two canted surfaces) straddling the engine exhaust

tellTales: Single jet engine on top of the fuselage behind the cabin
Small composite body that looks like a piston single with a jet on its back

confusedWith.howToTell: The Vision Jet has one engine on its back and a V-tail; the HondaJet has two engines over the wings and a T-tail.
The Vision Jet has a jet engine on its back and a V-tail; the SR20/SR22 has a nose propeller and conventional tail.
